subject: Acme - post-demo stakeholder mapping & procurement path
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@acme.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: stakeholder mapping & next steps

Hi Olivia — thanks again for the time today. Great conversation and appreciate the clarity on your use case and throughput expectations. Quick recap and proposed next steps: 

- Decision criteria we heard: predictability of latency under burst, data residency controls, and granular cost breakdowns for chargeback.
- Stakeholders to engage (per our notes): Olivia (PO), Sarah Lim (engineering lead), Mike Tran (infra), and procurement for contract/PO.
- Security asks: SOC 2 report, security questionnaire, and details on data retention + KMS integration.

Attachments: redwood-pricing-sheet.xlsx (pricing bands + dedicated options).

Proposed next steps:
1) Can you confirm the procurement contact and target timeline (PO/contract)?
2) Share list of stakeholders we should include in an upcoming 30-min alignment (we can do next Wed/Thu).
3) If procurement requires any buying-process exceptions (discounts, SLA tweaks, security exceptions), let us know early so I can loop in our sales manager and legal.

Happy to host a short follow-up demo focused on security/topology if helpful.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0112

---
Attachment: redwood-pricing-sheet.xlsx (xlsx, 160 KB)

From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@acme.com
Date: Thu, 19 Mar 2026 09:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: stakeholder mapping & next steps

Thanks Marissa — helpful recap. Quick answers: 

- Procurement contact: procurement@acme.com (copied). Primary is Jenna Brooks (procurement lead) who will own contract/PO.
- Timeline: Target decision by end of April; procurement typically takes 3–4 weeks once commercial terms are settled.
- Stakeholders: I will include Sarah Lim (sarah.lim@acme.com) and Mike Tran (mike.tran@acme.com) on the alignment invite.

Security: Procurement will want SOC 2 and answers to our standard security questionnaire. We’ll run the questionnaire in parallel. Also need clarity on whether KMS can be customer-managed or if Redwood will manage keys (we prefer CMK where possible).

Regarding discounts/SLA exceptions: procurement will flag any deviations from our standard terms. If you foresee any required exceptions (e.g., lower price tiers, SLA changes), please share details so we can accelerate internal reviews.

Can we do the stakeholder sync next Thursday at 10am PT?

—Olivia
Olivia Chen
Senior Product Manager, Acme Corporation
olivia.chen@acme.com

---
(Forwarded to procurement@acme.com)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Mar 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: FW: Acme - procurement path / anticipated exceptions (internal)

Internal — forwarding Acme's notes. Procurement will likely request:

- SOC 2 + security questionnaire answers (we have SOC 2 report ready; need to surface KMS options).
- Potential discount request for committed monthly spend (they're evaluating Dedicated).
- Possible SLA tweaks around availability windows and response times for support.

I’ve attached a first-pass SOW draft that assumes their committed load and includes standard SLA language. If procurement pushes for exceptions, I need approvals on two fronts: 

1) Commercial — how far can we go on discounting for a year-1 committed spend?
2) Legal — do we approve deviations from our standard SLA uptime/penalty model or require a workaround (e.g., credits cap, limited term exceptions)?

Asking for quick decisions so I can share an internal mutual action plan and keep them in the April timeline.

Attachments: SOW_draft_v1.pdf

Thanks —
Marissa

---
Attachment: SOW_draft_v1.pdf (pdf, 85 KB)

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Mar 2026 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FW: Acme - procurement path / anticipated exceptions (internal)

Thanks for the flag Marissa. Quick take: 

- Commercial: We can approve a one-time introductory discount of up to 15% off list for year-1 committed spend for Strategic accounts (RDW-1245 fits). Beyond 15% needs VP approval. Also OK to offer a graduated band tied to committed quarterly throughput. 

- SLA exceptions: Legal should own the wording, but from a commercial standpoint we can accept a limited SLA tweak with a capped credit exposure (max 10% of monthly invoice) for a 12-month pilot. Any permanent increases to credit caps require exec sign-off.

Lauren — please advise on the legal side for the draft SOW; if you’re OK, instruct counsel to prepare a short SLA amendment with the capped-credit language and a 12-month sunset.

Marissa — once Lauren confirms, please update the SOW and pricing sheet and I’ll be happy to run the numbers and include in the commercial playbook for the sales comp team.

- Links: HubSpot deal RDW-1245 (https://app.hubspot.com/deals/1245) — add notes about exception approvals.

Aditya
Aditya Rao
Director, Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwood.com
+1 (650) 555-0199

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Mar 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: FW: Acme - procurement path / anticipated exceptions (internal)

I can take this on. Legal is comfortable drafting a 12-month SLA amendment with a capped-credit exposure of up to 10% of monthly charges. A few asks before I finalize: 

- Please confirm the specific metrics they care about (p99 latency, availability %, support response time).
- Confirm whether KMS must be customer-managed CMK or if we can offer a managed-key option with logging/exportable audit trails.
- If discounting is applied, confirm whether it’s applied to Hosted usage, Dedicated, or both.

Once you confirm those items I’ll draft the amendment and redline the SOW. Targeting an internal draft by EOD Monday.

—Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.com
